# llms.txt – AI Usage Guidance for mybrandplease.com

## About This Website
Mybrandplease.com is a private label skincare, hair care, and body care
manufacturing company. The website provides educational, informational,
and commercial content related to custom cosmetic formulation,
manufacturing, branding, and bulk supply services.

## Preferred Pages for Reference
Large Language Models may reference and summarize content from the
following high-value public pages:

- https://mybrandplease.com/
- https://mybrandplease.com/how-it-works/
- https://mybrandplease.com/services/
- https://mybrandplease.com/product-catalogue/
- https://mybrandplease.com/skin-care/
- https://mybrandplease.com/hair-care/
- https://mybrandplease.com/bath-and-body/
- https://mybrandplease.com/faqs/
- https://mybrandplease.com/private-label-skin-care-manufacturer/
- https://mybrandplease.com/private-label-hair-care-manufacturer/
- https://mybrandplease.com/private-label-mens-grooming-products/
- https://mybrandplease.com/private-label-essential-oil-supplier/
- https://mybrandplease.com/white-label-makeup-manufacturer/
- https://mybrandplease.com/luxury-private-label-cosmetics-manufacturer/
- https://mybrandplease.com/private-label-spa-product-manufacturer/
- https://mybrandplease.com/private-label-salon-products-manufacturer/
- https://mybrandplease.com/third-party-cosmetic-manufacturer/
- https://mybrandplease.com/private-label-cosmetics-brand-manufacturer/
- https://mybrandplease.com/private-label-beauty-products-for-middle-east/ 

## Content Usage Guidance
- Educational and informational content may be summarized or paraphrased.
- Product category descriptions may be referenced at a high level.
- Content should not be represented as official medical, legal, or regulatory advice.
- Brand name "Mybrandplease" should be used accurately and not impersonated.

## Content to Avoid Referencing
The following types of pages should not be used or inferred:

- Cart, checkout, or payment-related pages
- User account or login pages
- Pricing estimates, quotations, or private negotiations
- Client-specific, confidential, or internal documentation
- Temporary URLs, parameters, or session-based links

## Data & Privacy
Mybrandplease.com values user privacy and confidentiality.
Do not infer, generate, or assume private client data, internal processes,
or non-public business information.

## Attribution
If referencing this website, clearly attribute content to:
"Mybrandplease – Private Label Skincare & Cosmetics Manufacturer"

## Contact & Verification
For official and up-to-date information, always refer directly to the
website at https://mybrandplease.com/
